200.description:
One GDACS event by its own identifier (eventtype + eventid) from events/geteventdata, or one episode of it from events/getepisodedata when episodeid is given: the full record plus the episode index (ids and detail URLs), impact resources (timeline, buffers, shakemap exports), image and document links. include_geometry adds the footprints from polygons/getgeometry for that episode (centroid, Poly_Green/Orange/Red wind buffers, track lines, Poly_Cones, earthquake intensity contours, flood extents); polygon_types narrows them (e.g. Green,Orange,Red for the ~24 KB wind buffers instead of ~400 KB). Unknown event or episode -> not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

to_date.description: Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after from_date. Default: today. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

200.description:
One page (100 rows) of the full GDACS event list for one segment: hazard types x calendar date window, from events/geteventlist/SEARCH with alertlevel=green;orange;red always sent (the API default silently hides Green). Rows are episodes ordered by todate descending; every record carries source_record_id gdacs:<eventtype>:<eventid>:<episodeid>, source_url, publication_id and retrieved_at. publication_id = segment + the newest datemodified on page 1. A window that ended more than 30 days ago is closed: later pages re-fetch page 1 and return invalid_input with issue code publication_changed when the pin moved. A window ending within 30 days of today is live (live: true, coverage partial): rows may shift between pages, so dedupe on source_record_id and reconcile with records_changes. Default segment: the current calendar month to today. Events overlapping the window (long droughts, cyclones) are included even when they started earlier.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Per-query search over events/geteventlist/SEARCH with GDACS's own filters: hazard types, alert levels, date window (default the last 7 days), English country name as GDACS writes it (e.g. Guam, Philippines) and minimum severity in the hazard's unit (magnitude for EQ, km/h for TC). 200.description:
Cheap version check for the GDACS event catalogue. Reads page 1 of the modified-since feed (events/geteventlist/latest, last hour, then last day) for the newest datemodified, and events/geteventlist/statistic for the year (year-to-date for the current year): total events, totals per alert level and per hazard type, plus a SHA-256 over the sorted unique eventtype:eventid keys of statistic.details[] as the content hash (GDACS publishes no hash). publication_id is gdacs:<newest datemodified>.

The response contains the tool result directly.
